claude.performance_metric: FFO/share fell from $2.04 (2017) to $1.73 (2018); comparable core NOI down 3.0% (enclosed retail down 3.5%); no divestiture, portfolio grew 98→108 centers
claude.rationale: The slice documents financial deterioration (declining FFO and net income, comparable NOI down 3.0%/3.5%, impairments in 2015–2017) driven by external tenant bankruptcies (Bon-Ton liquidation, Sears) rather than by any documented misfit between the acquired Glimcher product lines and the operating processes, so p4_pathway is coded 0. There is no documented fracture at the operations/organization interface — no evidence of operational integration breaking against people, management, or culture — so p5_pathway is coded 0. The company remained a going concern operating a single reportable segment with the enlarged portfolio retained; declines are attributed to macro retail/department-store conditions, not to realized integration disruption.

gemini.performance_metric: FFO per share/unit fell from $2.04 (2017) to $1.73 (2018)
gemini.rationale: The slice documents declining financial performance (FFO and net income) and tenant disruption (bankruptcies of Bon-Ton and Sears), but does not document any integration failures between products/processes (p4) or processes/organization (p5) resulting from a transaction. The disruptions are attributed to external market factors (department store bankruptcies).
